items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I know of a lot of trumpet players in New York that they couldn't get, Sidney de Paris Partis

ctx.x: I know of a lot of trumpet players in New York that they couldn't get, Sidney de Paris Partis, Leonard Davis. They would get Rex Stewart, Bobby Stark. There was a lot of trumpet players around there then that they could get that could play.

And there was a lot of good music came out of the rhythm club. But one of the most memorable days that I'll never forget at the rhythm club is when to me one of the greatest piano players that ever lived came through there. He come through New York --
